description: Rank candidate sheddase families by placental expression against their compatibility with the HEMO site geometry and sequence
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, requests
d = pd.DataFrame([
 ("ADAMTS1","secreted metalloproteinase (M12B)",230.0,"no"),
 ("MMP2","secreted metalloproteinase (M10)",210.8,"no"),
 ("ADAM12","membrane + secreted ADAM (M12B)",126.8,"no"),
 ("MMP14 / MT1-MMP","membrane-type MMP (M10)",111.7,"no"),
 ("ADAM9","membrane ADAM (M12B)",44.6,"no"),
 ("FURIN","proprotein convertase (S8)",38.2,"no (no R-X-[KR]-R in chain)"),
 ("ADAM10","membrane ADAM, ruler sheddase",27.1,"no"),
 ("MMP15 / MT2-MMP","membrane-type MMP (M10)",26.7,"no"),
 ("ADAM17","membrane ADAM, ruler sheddase",17.9,"no"),
 ("ST14 / matriptase","TTSP (S1)",14.2,"P1=Arg at the MINOR bond only"),
 ("ERVMER34-1 (substrate)","the substrate itself",10.2,"-"),
 ("BACE1","aspartic (A1)",12.6,"no"),
 ("BACE2","aspartic (A1)",2.8,"no"),
 ("ADAM28","membrane ADAM (M12B)",3.4,"no"),
 ("HPN / hepsin","TTSP (S1)",0.5,"P1=Arg at the MINOR bond only"),
 ("MEP1A / meprin alpha","astacin (M12A)",0.5,"no"),
 ("MMP16 / MT3-MMP","membrane-type MMP (M10)",0.9,"no"),
 ("MMP9","secreted metalloproteinase (M10)",1.9,"no"),
 ("MEP1B / meprin beta","astacin (M12A)",0.0,"no"),
 ("TMPRSS11D / HAT","TTSP (S1)",0.0,"P1=Arg at the MINOR bond only"),
], columns=["gene","class","placenta_nTPM","sequence_match_to_HEMO_site"]).sort_values("placenta_nTPM")
print(d.to_string(index=False))
d.to_csv(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),"ERVMER34-1_candidate_sheddase_placenta_table.csv"), index=False)

print("\nRanking: top placental metalloproteinases are secreted/soluble (ADAMTS1 230, MMP2 210.8) or")
print("placenta-enriched ADAM12 (126.8), all above the two canonical ruler sheddases ADAM10 (27.1) and ADAM17 (17.9).")
print("Meprins are effectively absent (MEP1A 0.5, MEP1B 0.0), excluding that family on expression grounds alone.")
print("HPA bulk placenta RNA, nTPM. Expression is necessary, not sufficient; no cell-type resolution, no protein level.")

colors=[]
for _,r in d.iterrows():
    if r.gene.startswith('ERVMER34'): colors.append('#000000')
    elif 'ruler' in r['class']: colors.append('#e53e3e')
    elif 'secreted' in r['class'] or 'ADAM12' in r.gene: colors.append('#2f855a')
    elif 'TTSP' in r['class']: colors.append('#d69e2e')
    elif 'astacin' in r['class']: colors.append('#718096')
    else: colors.append('#4299e1')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,7))
ax.barh(d.gene, d.placenta_nTPM, color=colors)
ax.set_xlabel('Human Protein Atlas placenta RNA (nTPM)')
ax.set_title('Candidate sheddases in placenta, the tissue where HEMO SHED is produced\n'
             'red = ADAM10/17 "molecular ruler" sheddases excluded by the 57-residue geometry;\n'
             'green = secreted or placenta-enriched metalloproteinases compatible with a distal site;\n'
             'grey = meprins, absent from placenta; black = the substrate ERVMER34-1', fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(d.placenta_nTPM): ax.text(v+3, i, f"{v:g}", va='center', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,265)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
